name: StarReel
description: Turn a script into a finished, downloadable AI short-drama episode: rewrite, cast and scenes, storyboards, frames, video, voice-over and final cut.
description_zh: 把剧本做成可下载的 AI 短剧成片：剧本改写、角色与场景提取、分镜、镜头图、视频、配音到成片，全流程预付费、大额步骤先报价。
description_en: Turn a script into a finished, downloadable AI short-drama episode: rewrite, cast and scenes, storyboards, frames, video, voice-over and final cut. Prepaid, with quotes before large spends.
examples_zh: 列出我在 StarReel 上的所有短剧项目
用我贴的这份剧本新建一部竖屏短剧，并先帮我改写剧本
查一下第 1 集现在做到哪一步了，还差什么
给这一集的分镜出首帧之前，先告诉我要花多少点
把第 1 集合成成片，给我下载链接
examples_en: List all my short-drama projects on StarReel
Create a vertical short drama from the script I pasted and rewrite it first
Show me how far episode 1 has progressed and what is left
Quote how many points the first frames for this episode will cost before generating
Compose episode 1 into a final cut and give me the download link
